application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Tree 1 – Bay Laurel (Laurus nobilis)
Location: Rear garden, left side against boundary wall
Height: Approximately 4–5 metres

Works Proposed:
Fell and remove the tree completely, including all stems

Grind out or cut back stump to below ground level to prevent regrowth

Reason:
The tree is oversized for the small garden, blocks daylight, sheds substantial leaves, and restricts usable garden space.

No amenity value to the wider conservation area.

Tree 2 – Tree of Heaven (Ailanthus altissima) (invasive species)

Location: Rear garden, right side near brick boundary wall
Height: Approximately 4–5 metres

Works Proposed:
Fell and remove the entire tree, including all stems

Treat stump to prevent regrowth (this species is known for aggressive suckering)

Reason:
This is a recognised invasive species that spreads rapidly, damages walls/foundations, and provides no positive landscape contribution.

Early removal is recommended before the tree establishes a larger root system.

General notes for both trees
*All resulting debris will be removed from site.
*Works will be carried out by a suitably qualified and insured tree surgeon.
*No replacement planting is proposed unless required by the council.
